# Synthetic route-dispatch regression fixture

`route-dispatch.json` contains fictional locations, couriers, shipments and explicitly supplied directed travel times. It is used to test bounded pickup/delivery construction and its typed adapter. It is not real travel data, an official catalog package, a carrier relationship or a publisher declaration.

The fixture and adapter follow the repository's Apache-2.0 routing interfaces and terms. The repository LICENSE applies; no existing attribution is removed, and no new license or copyright owner is asserted.
